data.text: **Question:** What is the difference between throw and throw ex?
throw preserves the original stack trace. throw ex resets the stack trace, losing the original error location.
Use throw to re-throw while preserving stack trace. throw ex creates a new exception origin, making debugging harder. Always use throw unless wrapping in a custom exception.
